_doc: FP viewmodel export contract. One entry per gun that ships clips. Names are API (research doc production/research/blender_godot_fp_pipeline_2026-07-25.md section 2.3): renaming an object, marker or NLA track here or in the .blend is a breaking change. Driver: tools/export_all_viewmodels.py. Validator: tools/validate_viewmodel_glb.py. Godot-side probe: tests/test_viewmodel_contract.tscn. Gameplay timers in weapon_tres are kept equal to the authored clip lengths by tools/sync_weapon_timers.py, which the export driver runs; validate_viewmodel_glb.py --check-timers fails on drift.
_contacts_doc: Marker/rail contract (war_room/2026-07-27_viewmodel_pipeline_v2): 'contacts' maps a contact-marker empty to the part it is parented to. A hand that manipulates a part is posed TO its marker, never eyeballed in free space; sliding parts keep origin-at-home 1-DOF rails. tools/audit_viewmodel_rigs.py measures hand-to-marker closest approach per clip and flags a reach that never closes to a true grab (FAKED IN AIR).
_staged_doc: 2026-07-27 transplant (tools/transplant_armory_parts.py): every fused gun copy replaced by its armory assembly with split moving parts + contact markers. When a gun below joins 'guns', move its entry's contacts map in and declare its parts. Rails clamped where travel is recorded: Ithaca37_pump x[0,0.045], M72_LAW_inner_tube x[0,0.230].

_items_doc: NON-GUN FP ITEMS (knife, radio handset, claymore, grenade, bandage). Same export driver and same validator as `guns`, three differences: the root key is `item_root` not `gun_root`; `markers` names its own required empties instead of the SightRear/SightFront/MuzzlePoint iron-sight set; and no `weapon_tres`, so sync_weapon_timers.py never runs against it. EVERYTHING ELSE IS THE SAME LAW: the clip set must match EXACTLY (no extras), and EVERY clip must carry a channel for EVERY listed part - a part with no track in a clip cannot reset in Godot and holds whatever pose the previous clip left it in. CLIP NAMES ARE LITERAL AND THE ENGINE ASKS FOR THEM BY STRING: weapon_holder.gd:929,937 ask for `rifle_idle` and `charge_handle`, so an item whose idle is named anything else plays NOTHING and sits in its rest pose. Keep `rifle_idle` as the idle clip name even on a knife - it is the engine's word for 'the held pose', not a claim about rifles. The object/marker names below are PLACEHOLDERS pending the authored rigs: correct them to whatever the .blend actually ships, then run `python tools/export_all_viewmodels.py <key>`.

knife._note: fire = the stab. The rear takedown reuses it; MeleeVerb decides lethality, not the clip.

handset._note: charge_handle = the RAISE to the ear (the engine's draw slot). Replaces the BoxMesh placeholder at player.gd:333.

claymore._note: fire = the plant. grip_R_Claymore in the blend was flagged as a GUESS - confirm it before export.

m26_grenade._note: charge_handle = pull the pin, fire = throw. Splitting M26_pin is what lets the pin actually leave.

bandage._note: fire = the wrap. Slot 4 (MEDKIT) currently plays no viewmodel at all.
